ballots_target_by_kind.name: ballots_target_by_kind
ballots_target_by_kind.value:
("ballots"."kind" = 'entry' and "ballots"."entry_id" is not null and "ballots"."target_member_id" is null and "ballots"."proposal" is not null)
        or ("ballots"."kind" = 'member' and "ballots"."target_member_id" is not null and "ballots"."entry_id" is null and "ballots"."proposal" is null)

ballots_outcome_reason_with_outcome.name: ballots_outcome_reason_with_outcome
ballots_outcome_reason_with_outcome.value: "ballots"."outcome_reason" is null or "ballots"."outcome" is not null

entries_amount_sign.name: entries_amount_sign
entries_amount_sign.value:
("entries"."reversal_of" is null and "entries"."amount" > 0)
        or ("entries"."reversal_of" is not null and "entries"."amount" < 0)

entries_reversal_reason_required.name: entries_reversal_reason_required
entries_reversal_reason_required.value: "entries"."reversal_of" is null or ("entries"."reversal_reason" is not null and trim("entries"."reversal_reason") <> '')
